text:
kai: heads-up — prefix cache hit-rate dropped from ~87% -> ~51% on dedicated after last night's fused-attn + quant kernel swap. p99 token latency +18%. suspect key canonicalization or kv key generation changed. rolling a rollback on one shard now.
perf-bot: Alert: cache_hit_rate.prefix down 36% | p99_token_latency 182ms -> 215ms | window 03:12-03:26 UTC | incident PERF-6423 created
samira: can you paste some example inputs / cache keys? any obvious tokenization diffs?
kai: grabbing samples. grepping cache key logs shows same prompt producing different keys across versions, tiny byte diff: 
```
# sample from pre-rollout node
pfx_key_old: 3f7a5b9d8c1a2f4e6b9d0c3a:len=24
# sample from post-rollout node
pfx_key_new: 3f7b5b9d8c1a2f4e6b9d0c3b:len=25
```
aj: ran a quick profiler on the canary. batching histogram shifted — more singleton batches after the kernel variant. continuous-batching window seems reduced, which increases cold prefixes. that accounts for ~3-4% of hit-rate delta.
maria: I checked the model-compile logs — tokenizer config flipped `token_norm=true` in compile job 2026-03-17T23:40, commit 9f4b2c. that toggles NFKC normalization.
kai: if tokenizer normalization changed, prefix byte sequence changes -> kv key input changes. did we also change the hash algorithm?
aj: yes, runtime flag `--kv-key-hash=blake2s` was enabled in the new kernel variant for perf reasons. different digest + length, but that alone shouldn't cause misswave if inputs identical.
maria: quick experiment matrix:
- old tokenizer + sha1 -> hit-rate 0.87
- old tokenizer + blake2s -> hit-rate 0.85
- new tokenizer + sha1 -> hit-rate 0.52
so tokenizer normalization is dominant cause.
samira: great repro. can we revert tokenizer toggle on the compiled model and check?
kai: rolled revert to one shard at 04:10 UTC. within 10 minutes that shard's hit-rate climbed back to 84%. p99 dropped from 215ms -> 188ms.
aj: confirmed micro-batching change is noise compared to the tokenizer effect, but it's real. the kernel's batching heuristic lowered the batching window to 15ms in the new scheduler. logging ticket for that separate.
maria: I'm opening a revert PR for the compile pipeline and adding a unit test to assert stable tokenization across model compile flags. also adding a normalization-canonicalization step inside the cache-key path as belt-and-suspenders.
samira: also recommend adding a `kv_key_divergence_rate` metric that compares digest pairs for canonical input sets across versions (canary vs stable). tag alerts at >5% divergence.
perf-bot: Action created: PERF-6423 — add key stability test, revert compile toggle. assignee: maria. priority: P0.
maria: PR created and smoke-tested on shard. merging now — estimate 2hrs for cluster rollout.
kai: after revert rollout cluster-wide, hit-rate baseline restored to ~86% and p99 settled ~190ms. continuing to monitor.
samira: please attach the 10k prompt smoke test gist when public. also add cost delta calc (token counts + extra generation).
aj: gist uploaded (internal link). shows cache hit curves and batch size histograms. will make a redacted public gist.
maria: follow-ups: 1) add pre-compile diff check to block accidental tokenizer flag flips, 2) add runtime canonicalization before hashing, 3) document kernel batching heuristic change and revert threshold.
kai: solid. let's close PERF-6423 when metrics stable for 24h. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
